mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyponatremia which may potentiate aromatase inhibitor-induced musculoskeletal adverse effects; both drugs can increase hyperglycemia risk in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, particularly potassium and sodium levels; assess for worsening joint pain or musculoskeletal symptoms; consider alternative antihypertensive if electrolyte disturbances occur.
